lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ga₂Cr₆Ge₂ (GaCr₃Ge) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a 20-atom unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements for Cr, Ga, and Ge, each with eight geometric neighbors per center atom, and the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show corner- and face-sharing between Cr polyhedra, and edge- and face-sharing between Cr and Ga or Ge polyhedra.
